points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 72c27c3 clean isolated build succeeds with shared externals; no tests registered. One partial steady diagnostic is not completion evidence.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:28–45 parses solve/case/output, rejects missing/unknown options; restart and report-level are parsed but not implemented.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, gas, partition, residual and output modules are separated, but many interfaces are no-op or disconnected.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal existing solver executable call found; external-copy investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case input and generic case enumeration, with no two-filename-only solver branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS call and owned/ghost structures exist; non-root global mesh remains empty and halo sends zero buffers without unpacking.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Halo buffers are intentionally leaked and zero-filled; geometry has incorrect cell-face volume signs; no completed runtime evidence.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build lists zero tests; no submitted validator or cases. One capped evaluator diagnostic stopped after last captured step 6000.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Named modules and build work, but reconstruct/limiter/viscous/output routines are no-op or placeholders.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
